title: Break in the interview
summary: Monk and Mary Kopcza discuss the waiting driver and a break or later session.

blocks.x: That’s great. You know what I’d like to do here, is I know our driver is waiting for you— MK: Oh, he’ll wait as long as he needs to. We just don’t want to tire you out after we left you in the lobby for 45 minutes.
He can wait? Okay. Because I thought we could come back. MK: We can take a break, or we can do more another time, or we can, any number—
Is there something else? I mean you have a million stories, I can tell.
